answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond before accepting paid work, released only after a cooling period of verified, completed jobs. A sybil operator pays the same frozen capital per identity, so spawning a nebula of fake accounts drains real funds instead of scaling for free. New identities start in a shallow lagoon of low-value tasks and earn their way out through auditable work, while reputation earned in one cluster cannot be carried across the tundra of unrelated domains, so a fake history bought in one niche buys nothing elsewhere.
